| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Smoothing size** `sigmaSpace` | 3 | 0.5 to 10 px | The spatial sigma of each bilateral pass. |
| **Color tolerance** `sigmaRange` | 40 | 1 to 150 | The range sigma of each bilateral pass, a distance between RGB colors. |
| **Passes** `passes` | 2 | 1 to 5 | How many times the bilateral filter runs. |
| **Line window** `lineSize` | 9 | 3 to 31, odd px | The window of the local mean that the lines compare with. |
| **Line threshold** `lineOffset` | 4 | 0 to 30 | How much darker than its surroundings a pixel must be to become a line. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
